clauses.reason: The order is a single determination and extension: having determined that failure to continue peaceful nuclear cooperation with the European Atomic Energy Community would be seriously prejudicial to United States non-proliferation objectives, the President extends the duration of the period specified in the first proviso to Section 126a(2) of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 to March 10, 1987. The extension therefore runs by its own terms to March 10, 1987, recorded inclusive (the period runs through that day; the exclusive reading ends it when March 10 begins). Executive Order No. 12587, signed March 9, 1987 before that date, extended the period to March 10, 1988 without revoking or superseding this order; that and the later annual extension orders (Executive Orders 12629, 12670, 12706, 12753, 12791, 12840 and 12903, whose texts are held) are later events, each of which recites this order in a list of earlier extensions. Executive Orders 12629, 12706, 12753, 12791, 12840 and 12903 each state that the immediately preceding extension order shall be superseded on the effective date of the new order (12629 supersedes 12587, 12706 supersedes 12670, 12753 supersedes 12706, 12791 supersedes 12753, 12840 supersedes 12791 and 12903 supersedes 12840); Executive Orders 12587 and 12670 contain no supersession sentence. None of them supersedes or revokes this order, so none is treated as ending it. The effective date of each later order is taken as its signing date because none states a different one.

research_rationale:
Identity confirmed against the census register (executive order of 1986-02-28, Nuclear Cooperation With EURATOM) and the held Federal Register text at 51 FR 7423, whose text layer shows the March 4, 1986 issue. The order has one operative sentence, an extension to a stated date, March 10, 1987, which is the first end by its own terms. The held texts of the later extension orders show a chain of annual extensions that recite this order; none revokes or supersedes it.

savings.reason: Peaceful nuclear cooperation with the European Atomic Energy Community carried on during the period this order extended (through March 10, 1987) is an accrued effect of the extension; the order contains no command that continues after that date, and later extensions are separate acts of later orders.
